q: By the end of 2030, South Korea or Japan formalizes one of the following: a decision to develop nuclear weapons, withdrawal from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), or abandonment of its non-nuclear principles
basis: The condition for nuclear dominoes · From the 2030 futures in the Korean Peninsula analysis
rs: Official announcements by the South Korean or Japanese government, or a notice of withdrawal from the NPT
